nodes.summary: colcon builds that pick up the system Eigen instead of a vendored one: set Eigen3_DIR explicitly and require CMake >= 3.22.
nodes.body:
Symptom: link errors against Eigen symbols after a clean build.
Cause: colcon finds the system Eigen3 first.
Fix: `colcon build --cmake-args -DEigen3_DIR=/opt/eigen/share/eigen3/cmake` and pin CMake 3.22 in package.xml.
Verified on: ROS 2 Humble, Ubuntu 22.04, 2026-09-14

nodes.summary: ros2 launch cannot find a package after a build: source install/setup.bash in the same shell first.
nodes.body:
Symptom: `ros2 launch` says package not found right after `colcon build`.
Fix: `source install/setup.bash` in the shell that runs launch; verified 2026-09-10 on Humble.

nodes.summary: pandas groupby over a categorical column silently includes empty categories: pass observed=True.
nodes.body:
Symptom: groupby sums have rows of zeros for unused categories.
Fix: `df.groupby(col, observed=True)`; pandas 2.2, verified 2026-08-30.

nodes.summary: pint is missing inside the sandbox: pip install --user pint and export PYTHONPATH to the user site.
nodes.body:
Symptom: ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'pint'.
Fix: `pip install --user pint` then `export PYTHONPATH=$HOME/.local/lib/python3.12/site-packages`; verified 2026-10-02.

nodes.summary: Parquet writes from pandas need pyarrow: install pyarrow 15 or the write fails with an engine error.
nodes.body:
Symptom: `ImportError: Unable to find a usable engine` on `to_parquet`.
Fix: `pip install pyarrow==15.0.2`; verified 2026-09-21.

nodes.summary: Bedrock short-term tokens expire within 12 hours: read the token from a file on every call so a rotation needs no restart.
nodes.body:
Symptom: HTTP 403 from Bedrock after a few hours.
Fix: set `AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK_FILE=/path/token` and overwrite the file to rotate; verified 2026-10-05.

nodes.summary: Unit conversions for emission factors: keep everything in kg CO2e per kWh and convert with pint at the boundary.
nodes.body: Fix: `ureg = pint.UnitRegistry(); (x * ureg('g/MJ')).to('kg/kWh')`; a factor of 3.6 MJ/kWh; verified 2026-10-03.

nodes.summary: A LaTeX table with too many columns in the report: use tabularx with X columns and \small.
nodes.body: Fix: `\begin{tabularx}{\textwidth}{lXXr}` plus `\small`; verified 2026-09-25 with TeX Live 2024.

nodes.summary: Chose Parquet over SQLite for episode logs in p-0412 because downstream analysis is columnar; revisit if write latency matters.
nodes.body: Alternatives: SQLite (simple, row-oriented), CSV (no types). Chose Parquet: columnar reads 10x faster for the analysis notebooks; write latency 40 ms acceptable. Decided 2026-09-20.

nodes.summary: Use a 2024 USD cost basis for the LCA model; inflate older sources with the CPI table in model/cpi.csv.
nodes.body: Alternatives: 2020 USD (more sources), nominal. Chose 2024 USD per the human answer to Q3; inflation via `model/cpi.csv` (BLS, accessed 2026-10-02).

nodes.summary: Allocation by mass rather than by economic value for the co-products in the sodium-ion LCA.
nodes.body: Alternatives: economic allocation, system expansion. Chose mass allocation: prices for the by-product vary 3x year to year; ISO 14044 step 2. Decided 2026-10-04.

nodes.summary: p-0398 overran by 3 days because integration tests were left to the end; start them by day 2 on multi-service projects.
nodes.body: Evidence: journal days 8-11 of p-0398; 3 days of rework after integration. Lesson: integration test scaffold by day 2.

nodes.summary: The first live run spent its budget on literature discovery and never produced a number; build a crude end-to-end model on day 1.
nodes.body: Evidence: 1.6M tokens over 72 calls, no headline number (p-0501 run 1, 2026-10-05). Lesson: crude model first, then research the gaps it exposes.

nodes.summary: Cold-eyes reviews found the week two-thirds process and one-third substance; cap ritual wakes at five steps.
nodes.body: Evidence: reviews/week-01.md of p-0501; the daily ritual took 12 steps on 2026-10-06. Lesson: rituals are bookkeeping, aim for five steps.

nodes.body: Scoped pipeline; Eigen link errors after clean build; fixed with Eigen3_DIR; review handoff.
